title: Vitamux healthkit.samples.v1 item body
description: Body of one ingest item of stream healthkit.samples.v1: one HKAnchoredObjectQuery page of one type, as sent by HealthBridgeKit (apple/HealthBridgeKit). Raw HealthKit values in the units of the type registry; the server converts. Percent types are fractions (0.97), as HealthKit reports them. Only additive, optional changes within v1; the Apple Watch fields (workout_uuid, ecg, beats, route, state_of_mind, activity_summary, workout.stats, workout.events, workout.activities) were added by ADR-0024. See docs/architecture/apple-health.md#payload.

type.description: Full HealthKit identifier, e.g. HKQuantityTypeIdentifierHeartRate, HKCorrelationTypeIdentifierBloodPressure, HKWorkoutTypeIdentifier, HKDataTypeIdentifierHeartbeatSeries, HKWorkoutRouteTypeIdentifier; for activity summaries the identifier of HKObjectType.activitySummaryType().

before_hash.description: Hash of the anchor the query started from; none for a full pull.

type.description: HealthKit type identifier; set on correlation members only.

start.description: RFC 3339 with the offset of HKTimeZone, else of the phone.

value.description: Quantity in unit, or the raw category value (no unit).

unit.description: HKUnit string, e.g. count/min, mmHg, %, degC, mg/dL.

device.description: HKDevice, when the writer set one.

metadata.description: HealthKit metadata: numbers (booleans as 0/1), strings; dates as RFC 3339 UTC, quantities as their description.

totals.description: Sums by quantity type identifier, in the registry unit.

workout_uuid.description: The workout this sample belongs to, when HealthKit links it: a route's workout (predicateForObjectsFromWorkout), an effort score's workout (HKWorkoutEffortRelationshipQuery).

classification.description: HKElectrocardiogram.Classification raw value: 0 not set, 1 sinus rhythm, 2 atrial fibrillation, 3 inconclusive low heart rate, 4 inconclusive high heart rate, 5 inconclusive poor reading, 6 inconclusive other, 100 unrecognized.

symptoms_status.description: HKElectrocardiogram.SymptomsStatus raw value: 0 not set, 1 none, 2 present.

lead.description: HKElectrocardiogram.Lead raw value of the voltages (1 = Apple Watch, similar to lead I).

voltage_count.description: numberOfVoltageMeasurements; voltages has this many entries.

voltages.description: One voltage per measurement, in order.

offsets_s.description: timeSinceSampleStart per measurement; sent only when the spacing differs from 1/sampling_frequency_hz.

beats.description: HKHeartbeatSeriesSample with its beats (HKHeartbeatSeriesQuery); both arrays have count entries.

preceded_by_gap.description: precededByGap per beat: true when beats before it were not recorded.

route.description: HKWorkoutRoute with its locations (HKWorkoutRouteQuery) as parallel arrays of count entries. CoreLocation values as given: a negative accuracy, speed or course means invalid.

offsets_s.description: Location timestamp minus the sample start, in seconds.

kind.description: HKStateOfMind.Kind raw value: 1 momentary emotion, 2 daily mood.

activity_summary.description: HKActivitySummary of one day (HKActivitySummaryQuery). It has no UUID, source or anchor: uuid is the UUIDv5 of the day, start and end bound the local day, source_revision is the fixed marker vitamux.activity-summary (ADR-0024).

date.description: The summary's day (its dateComponents in the phone's calendar).

move_mode.description: HKActivityMoveMode raw value: 1 active energy, 2 move time.

stats.description: Discrete statistics by quantity type identifier, in the registry unit (e.g. heart rate average, minimum and maximum).

type.description: HKWorkoutEventType raw value: 1 pause, 2 resume, 3 lap, 4 marker, 5 motion paused, 6 motion resumed, 7 segment, 8 pause or resume request.

end.description: Equal to start for an event without a duration.

workout_activity.description: HKWorkoutActivity: one leg of a multisport workout, or one interval.

location_type.description: workoutConfiguration.locationType raw value: 1 unknown, 2 indoor, 3 outdoor.
